title: Triple torsion, triple cup products, and embedding obstructions for rational homology 3-spheres
summary: Freedman and Krushkal introduced a triple torsion linking form for rational homology $3$-spheres and used it to obstruct locally flat embeddings in $S^4$. For every odd prime $p$, we identify their triple torsion form, computed with parameter $t=p$ on rational homology $3$-spheres whose first homology has exponent $p$, with the mod-$p$ triple cup product under torsion-linking duality. For algebraically split $\pm p$-framed surgery links, this gives a signed formula in terms of Milnor's integral length-three invariants $\barμ_{ijk}$, with the framing-sign factor dictated by torsion-linking…
